_note: Cut templates are data the owner DS reviews; the runner (cuts.py) is fixed. Each produces one metric per arm: a ratio of sums over users (x over y), compared with control by a delta-method interval clustered by user. Columns are written as t.<name> with the synthetic names; the overlay's t3_columns renames them at work. surface_shift_is_the_question marks a per-user count, or a cut whose question is the surface shift itself; the full-page guard doesn't apply to it.

full_page_share.x: CASE WHEN t.experience = 'surface_full' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

answer_no_click.produces: Answered without a 1P click, share of full-page queries
answer_no_click.x: CASE WHEN t.answer_success = 1 AND t.any_click_1p = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

primary_by_exposure_day.produces: Search Success Rate by days since first exposure

unauth_queries.produces: Full-page queries per user without connected apps

ta_known_item_unauth.produces: Typeahead resolution of known-item queries, users without connected apps

p1_long_no_answer.produces: 1P long-click share, full-page queries with no answer
